headline: A college in Illinois tried to cancel its Flock contact and it refused
summary: Elgin Community College attempted to terminate its contract for Flock safety cameras. The college cited concerns over data sharing with CBP and insecure camera feeds. Flock Safety, however, refused to cancel the agreement.

headline: Silicon Valley is falling in line with Trump’s attempt to rename AI
summary: President Trump is attempting to rebrand Artificial Intelligence as "super intelligence." Some powerful figures in Silicon Valley are adopting this new term. The general public largely continues to use the term 'AI'.

headline: The new Apple TV could have a built-in mic and a remote with a speaker
summary: Rumors suggest the next Apple TV will feature a built-in microphone. Its upgraded remote is also expected to include a speaker. This could enable hands-free Siri control and expand smart home integration.

headline: NASA dumped over 800GB of Artemis II data online
summary: NASA has publicly released over 800GB of data from the Artemis II mission. The archive includes 11,000+ photos, videos, and 8.5 hours of audio. Crew-annotated data is also part of the extensive online dump.

headline: New NetEase FPS Sparks Warzone 'Rip-Off' Claims, But Some Call of Duty Fans Are Happy to See It
summary: NetEase Games' new FPS, ECC: Redline, faces accusations of being a Call of Duty: Warzone 'rip-off.' The game has sparked divided reactions among Call of Duty fans. Some players welcome it as a potential alternative to Warzone.

headline: Tekken 8 Yujiro Teaser Reveals Baki Rep's In-Game Render Is Just as Uncanny as Fans Expected
summary: Bandai Namco has unveiled the first look at Tekken 8 DLC character Yujiro Hanma. The Baki rep's in-game render is described as 'uncanny,' meeting fan expectations. Fans are reacting to the distinctive visual style of the new fighter.

headline: ‘I’m Shocked That People Are Still Playing’ – How GTA 5 Took Over the World
summary: GTA 5 has sold over 230 million copies, solidifying its place as one of history's biggest games. Millions of players continue to engage with the game weekly, over a decade after its release. The article explores the enduring global phenomenon of GTA 5.

headline: Marvel Tokon DLC Roadmap Reveals First Look at Jane Foster Thor, Venom and Jubilee Coming in 2027
summary: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls unveiled its Year 1 DLC roadmap. Jane Foster Thor is confirmed to arrive as a new character this winter. Venom and Jubilee are slated to join the roster in 2027.

headline: Saudi capital airport hit by second Houthi strike in two days
summary: Riyadh's capital airport has been struck for the second time in two days by Houthi forces. The Yemeni group claims responsibility for recent attacks that killed 13 people in Riyadh. Houthi targets over the weekend included two airports and oil facilities.

headline: PM says it is 'clear' Russia interfered with Brexit vote
summary: The UK Prime Minister asserts it is 'clear' Russia interfered in the Brexit vote. He stated voters were not sufficiently informed about foreign actors' attempts to disrupt UK democracy. The claims highlight concerns over external influence on democratic processes.

headline: Wildlife park remains closed after fatal tiger attack
summary: Yorkshire Wildlife Park remains closed following a fatal tiger attack on Saturday. A man reportedly entered the tiger enclosure and was killed. Authorities are conducting an investigation into the tragic incident.

headline: Poland detains man suspected of planning assassination of PM Tusk
summary: Polish police have detained a man suspected of plotting to assassinate Prime Minister Donald Tusk. Authorities received credible intelligence about potential attacks against Tusk and his defense minister. The investigation is ongoing to determine the full extent of the threat.
